item.coloph: bcom ldan 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang bstod phyag 'tshal/_dge slong ma zla mdzes kyis bstod pa mdzad pa rdzogs so/_/'di ni rgya gar shar phyogs kyi btsun pa tsan+d+ra shrI'i ngag las 'byung ba dang rgya dpe bstun nas dge slong bsod nams rnam rgyal gyis bsgyur ba'o/_/spyan ras gzigs dbang mgon po mchog la bstod pa yi/_bsod nams gang zhing zla ba dung ltar nges/_rgyal ba kun gyi sras kyi thu bo de ltar bur/_sdug bsngal 'gro la mi 'jigs rtsol ba nyid gyur cig_/ral pa 'chang zhing shin tu zhib yangs pa'i spyan/_rtag par rab tu dang ba zla ba'i dkyil 'khor zhal/_lha dang lha min rnams kyis zhabs kyi 'dam skyes la/_phyag byas nor bu pad+ma las byung mgon por 'dud/_'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug la/_klu'i rgyal po nor rgyas kyis bstod pa/_dpal nags kyi rin chen gyi zhal sngar bsod nams rnam par rgyal bas bsgyur ba'o
